More about Treble.ai
Made with AI Edit
Treble.ai is a Colombian software company that provides a platform for businesses to automate customer communication and marketing campaigns through WhatsApp.
The company's platform integrates with popular CRM and business tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, and Google Sheets, allowing businesses to manage their customer interactions from a single place.
Treble.ai's business model is based on a subscription service, where businesses pay a monthly or annual fee to use the platform.
The company serves a wide range of clients, from small and medium-sized businesses to large enterprises, across various industries. The platform enables businesses to create automated customer journeys, send targeted messages, and track the performance of their campaigns.
Treble.ai has raised a total of $15 million in funding and reported a revenue of $5.7 million in 2024. The company is headquartered in Bogota, Colombia, and has a team of 63 employees.
